Hermit lizard

Overview

Hermit lizard helps Zak escape the Khadaganian expedition in return for a promise to visit his home. He then asks Zak to restore water diverted by the orcs. In exchange he shares what the lizards know of the ancient magician and explains the tunnel route toward his dwelling, including its dangerous golems. His attempts at human humour are considerably less reassuring. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]

The expedition and the Hermit’s bargain

Estera introduces a lost Khadaganian official, who promises that his expedition can help Zak leave Gipath. Meeting Expedition commander instead leads to imprisonment and demands for information about a meteorite. Zak plays the ignorant swineherd, but the commander threatens torture. Hermit lizard offers escape on the condition that Zak later visit his home. Zak gives his word, receives the Ancient Claw for the traps on the approach and escapes. The Hermit explains that he had intended to negotiate with the armoured humans but changed his mind after seeing their treatment of Zak. Keeping the promise establishes trust where the expedition failed to do so. [6, 7, 8, 1, 2, 3]

The Hermit’s gift and dangerous joke

The Hermit offers more than directions. He gives Zak an object resembling a horn or shell, hoping it will help him survive, although he cannot explain how a human should use it. His advice about treasure is less benevolent. During their negotiations he points Zak toward the southern lizard islands and says their gold will be his. Zak can follow that lead, only to find hostile owners who pursue the intruder. When confronted, the Hermit calls the misleading invitation a joke, imitating the humour Zak had used with him. Zak makes clear that he does not find the experience amusing. [3, 9, 5, 10, 11]

Water for the lizards and the Great Magician

The Hermit needs the water diverted by the orcs restored. Zak raises their dam and blocks the diversion canal; in return the lizard locates the magician in a ravine in the Remote Mountains. This information joins the tunnel instructions from the Khadaganian report. Zak passes the ancient defences and reaches Tka Rik (Tka-Lithan Richti-Nik). Tka-Rik explains that his dragonet has watched Zak since his unusual arrival. Bound to Gipath by his duty as its Great Magician, he offers help with Zak’s memory in exchange for bringing him two surviving young Joons. The first journey will be to Ingos to find the girl. Zak must leave his Gipath companions behind. Tka-Rik supplies an amulet for the return journey, but warns that it will work only once the girl has been found; his dragonet will travel with Zak. [3, 12, 4, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18]
